ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio (~0.05); surface is dominated by low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels with sparse high-intensity white micro-clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-pixel field across both lobes; small, high-intensity white circular clusters (mottling) scattered medially on both lobes; a linear cluster of white spots following the upper-right distal margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 145 degrees; basal vertex is partially obscured by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire perimeter; extreme irregularity and deep indentations (ragged profile) concentrated at the terminal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a shallow convex sweep; right lobe displays a more pronounced upward vertical trajectory with a complex concave-to-convex transition near the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-relief, high-contrast pixel clusters exhibiting extreme texture at the distal tips of both lobes, representing localized bio-fouling or calcified scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-grey linear pixel disruptions oriented vertically/diagonally on the central-right lobe surface, breaking the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme terminal tip degradation; the distal ends of both lobes appear heavily eroded and jagged compared to standard fluke morphology.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, 'fringe-like' texture at the extreme lateral edges of the flukes, characterized by deep, irregular pixel voids and protrusions.
